rows.grounds: concluding particle marking the end of the teaching
the entirety of what has been taught

items.question: What is the status of the complete teaching about Kālikā that has been declared?
premises: The speaker concludes the discourse with 'thus'.
Everything concerning Kālikā has been told to the listener.
This complete teaching is declared to be very hard to obtain.
items.inference: The entire doctrine of Kālikā imparted here is supremely rare and difficult to access.
items.plain_english: Thus, all of this concerning Kālikā, which is very hard to obtain, has been told to you.
